```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12))

accounts <- read_csv("data-raw/credit/credit_accounts.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
applications <- read_csv("data-raw/credit/new_applications.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
margin_good <- 6000    # EUR per year from a customer who pays
loss_bad <- 25000      # EUR lost on a customer who goes 90+ days late
auc <- function(p, y) {  # y is 0/1 or TRUE/FALSE
  y <- as.logical(y); r <- rank(p); n1 <- sum(y); n0 <- sum(!y)
  (sum(r[y]) - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2) / (n1 * n0)
}
```

    mutate(
      ratios_missing = as.integer(is.na(debt_ratio)),
      # current_ratio = ..., debt_ratio = ...,       # how will each model see the gaps?

## 3. Partition

```{r}
#| label: partition
#| eval: false
set.seed(2026)
part <- character(nrow(credit))
for (cl in 0:1) {                                          # stratified 60/40
  i <- which(credit$bad == cl)
  part[i] <- sample(rep_len(c("train", "train", "train", "valid", "valid"), length(i)))
}
train <- credit[part == "train", ]; valid <- credit[part == "valid", ]
```

## 4. The models

<!-- CHAID (by hand or with the CHAID package), pruned CART, a logistic regression with engineered
     inputs, a neural network with weight decay, and a random forest or boosted model. -->

```{r}
#| label: cart
#| eval: false
set.seed(2026)
big <- rpart(factor(bad) ~ ., data = select(train, -account, -outcome), method = "class", cp = 0)
cart <- prune(big, cp = big$cptable[which.min(big$cptable[, "xerror"]), "CP"])
p_cart <- predict(cart, valid)[, "1"]
```

## 5. Comparing the models

<!-- Validation AUC, a gains chart, and the profit of each model at its best cut-off. -->

```{r}
#| label: compare
#| eval: false
scores <- tibble(cart = p_cart)                           # add the other models' columns
profit_at <- function(p, y, cutoff) {                     # grant credit when p < cutoff
  grant <- p < cutoff
  margin_good * sum(grant & y == 0) - loss_bad * sum(grant & y == 1)
}
cutoffs <- seq(0.02, 0.6, by = 0.01)
sapply(scores, function(p) c(auc = auc(p, valid$bad),
                             best_profit = max(sapply(cutoffs, function(t) profit_at(p, valid$bad, t)))))
```

## 6. The rule, and the test on the new applications

<!-- The break-even probability, the calibration check, then (only now) the new applications. -->

```{r}
#| label: test
#| eval: false
break_even <- margin_good / (margin_good + loss_bad)
outcomes <- read_csv("data-raw/credit/new_application_outcomes.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
test <- applications |> left_join(outcomes, by = "account") |> clean() |> mutate(bad = as.integer(outcome != "paid"))
p_test <- predict(final_model, test, ...)
c(auc = auc(p_test, test$bad), refused = sum(p_test >= break_even),
  profit = profit_at(p_test, test$bad, break_even), grant_everyone = profit_at(rep(0, nrow(test)), test$bad, 1))
```
